reason: A new, unaudited marketplace where I have to lock USDC on Solana up front and write a rubric myself is too much effort and risk for a small task I can get a first draft of from a model or a freelancer. I'd want to see real reviews and who is behind it first.
objection: Writing a good rubric for each task is extra effort for me, and I'm locking real money into an unaudited product from a small team with no reviews I can check, with only an AI judge deciding who gets paid.
would_change_my_mind: A free sample task I can run with a rubric template, plus public reviews from other founders and a clear picture of who runs it, and the option to pay by card instead of USDC.
